title: A Shopping Trip
description: Practise the past simple, comparatives and linking words, then write a diary entry about a shopping trip.
instructions: Do the exercises in Part 1. Then write your text in Part 2.

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct answer.
exercises.text: I ___ a new pair of trainers at the shopping centre.
exercises.explanation: "Buy" is irregular: buy - bought. Be careful: "brought" is the past of "bring".

exercises.prompt: Write the correct form of the word in brackets.
exercises.text: The blue jacket was ___ (expensive) than the black one.
exercises.explanation: Long adjectives use "more" to make the comparative: expensive - more expensive.

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct answer.
exercises.text: We met ___ the entrance at ten o'clock.
exercises.explanation: Use "at" for a meeting point or a specific place: at the entrance.

exercises.prompt: Put the words in the correct order to make a sentence.
exercises.explanation: "Too" goes before an adjective and means "more than is good": too expensive.

exercises.prompt: There is one mistake in the sentence. Write the correct sentence.
exercises.text: We goed to three different shops.
answers: We went to three different shops.
exercises.explanation: "Go" is irregular: go - went, not "goed".

exercises.prompt: Complete the sentence with "so" or "because".
exercises.text: We had lunch in a cafe ___ we were hungry.
exercises.explanation: "Because" introduces a reason: we were hungry.

exercises.prompt: There is one mistake in the sentence. Write the correct sentence.
exercises.explanation: Adverbs of frequency go before the main verb: I never go.

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct answer.
exercises.explanation: "Money" is uncountable, so we ask "How much...?". We use "How many...?" with plural nouns.

exercises.prompt: Write the correct form of the word in brackets.
exercises.text: My sister ___ (spend) all her pocket money on a T-shirt.
exercises.explanation: "Spend" is irregular: spend - spent.

exercises.prompt: Put the words in the correct order to make a sentence.
answers: We couldn't find any cheap jeans.
exercises.explanation: We use "any" in negative sentences: We couldn't find any cheap jeans.

exercises.prompt: There is one mistake in the sentence. Write the correct sentence.
exercises.text: This is the cheapest shop of the town.
answers: This is the cheapest shop in the town.
This is the cheapest shop in town.
exercises.explanation: After a superlative we use "in" with places: the cheapest shop in the town.

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct answer.
exercises.text: While we ___ for the bus, it started to rain.
exercises.explanation: We use the past continuous (was/were + -ing) for a longer action that was in progress when something else happened.

exercises.prompt: Write the correct form of the word in brackets.
exercises.text: That bag looks heavy. I ___ (carry) it for you.
exercises.explanation: We use "will" + base verb to offer help when we decide at the moment of speaking: I will carry it.

exercises.prompt: Put the words in the correct order to make a sentence.
exercises.explanation: Question word + did + subject + base verb: What did you buy?

exercises.prompt: There is one mistake in the sentence. Write the correct sentence.
exercises.text: I bought a new clothes for the party.
answers: I bought new clothes for the party.
I bought some new clothes for the party.
exercises.explanation: "Clothes" is always plural, so we cannot use "a" with it. Use no article or "some".

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct answer.
exercises.text: I liked the red dress, so I bought ___.
exercises.explanation: We use the object pronoun "it" for one thing: the dress - it.

exercises.prompt: Complete the sentence with "so" or "but".
exercises.text: I wanted the red shoes, ___ they didn't have my size.
exercises.explanation: "But" introduces a contrast or a problem: I wanted them, but they didn't have my size.

exercises.prompt: Put the words in the correct order to make a sentence.
exercises.explanation: We use "for" + a period of time to say how long: for two hours.

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct answer.
exercises.text: Look at that long queue! We ___ wait a long time.
exercises.explanation: We use "be going to" for a prediction when we can see the evidence now: Look at the queue! We are going to wait.

exercises.prompt: There is one mistake in the sentence. Write the correct sentence.
exercises.text: The shop assistant carryed my bags to the car.
answers: The shop assistant carried my bags to the car.
exercises.explanation: Verbs ending in consonant + y change y to i before -ed: carry - carried.

task.prompt: Write a diary entry about a shopping trip.
contentPoints: Say where you went and who with.
Say what you bought and why.
Say what you did not buy and why.
Say what you did after shopping and how you felt.
task.modelAnswer:
Saturday, 21st October

Dear Diary,

Today I went to the new shopping centre with my mum. First, we looked for trainers for school. I bought a white pair because they were cheaper than the black ones. Then I saw a lovely blue jacket, but it was too expensive, so I didn't buy it. After that, we had lunch in a cafe. I was tired but happy.
